self._title_label.setStyleSheet(
            f"font-size: {scaled_pt(int(themes.prop('font_size', 'xl')))}px; font-weight: bold; color: {themes.color('heading')}; background: transparent;")

self._url_label.setStyleSheet(

scroll.setStyleSheet(f"QScrollArea {{ background: {sk.token('panel')}; border: none; }}"

self._name.setStyleSheet(
            f"font-size: {_font('xl')}px; font-weight: bold; color: {self._t['heading']}; "

self._name.setStyleSheet(

            f"  border: {scaled_px(1)}px solid {focus_border}; "

self.setStyleSheet(
            f"#firstRunCard {{"

            f"    stop:0 {themes.color('panel')}, stop:1 {themes.color('base')}); "

            f"}}"

            f"  background: {hover_bg}; "
            f"}}"

            f"  border: {scaled_px(1)}px solid {focus_border}; "
            f"}}")

            f"QMenu::item:selected {{ background: {themes.color('accent')}; }}")

self._status.setStyleSheet(

btn.setStyleSheet(

        f"background: {themes.header_for_dock()}; "
